info.name: A Word from the Assistant
info.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient

descriptions.inProgress: Spiruna's assistant quietly tells me that at this point, nothing will bring her back to her senses, unless I bring an item called #bFairy Dust#k, the only item that'll restore the cracked black crystal to its original state. #bKriel the Fairy#k of Orbis Department Store may have it.
